patch.value: Keep enabled Slack lifecycle notifications durable across restarts

Persist Slack-only delivery intents, idempotency identities and acknowledgments. Existing immediate retry/backoff remains transport logic; pm-observer owns evidence-note delivery into PM only. CLI lifecycle hooks currently send without a durable receipt; sibling pm-slack-standup builds digests rather than delivering lifecycle intents. No duplicate open outbox item found; tracker-reconciliation items are excluded.

Crash/retry fixtures produce one acknowledged send; ambiguous remote outcomes remain visible; notification failure never rolls back a committed item.; Typed SDK and agent-sized CLI output, typed refusals with remedies, README and example, no-git regressions, public tracker copy validation, unchanged npm and Bun CI release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap recheck: CLI lifecycle hooks expose successful command results but no Slack-specific durable delivery acknowledgment. pm-slack currently retries immediate HTTP attempts only. pm-observer src/delivery.ts and src/store.ts own idempotent PM evidence notes, and pm-slack-standup owns digests. This feature owns Slack delivery intents and receipts only. Plan: opt-in durable storage, atomic claims and idempotency, persisted uncertain outcomes with explicit reconciliation, bounded SDK and CLI inspection/drain, real no-git tracker regressions and public tracker-copy validation. Reconciliation PR items remain untouched.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text:
Verified the three unresolved CodeRabbit threads against the current head. No outside-diff findings were in the latest CodeRabbit review body.

PRRT_kwDOSYpJkM6vA2RC is valid: the published SDK example caught OutboxError and exited 0. The example now sets process.exitCode from the refusal. The same example also treated a pre-request fetch failure as an uncertain throw; it now returns retry for ENOTFOUND, EAI_AGAIN and ECONNREFUSED by socket code.

PRRT_kwDOSYpJkM6vA2RG is valid: postToSlackOnce dropped the socket error code, and sendOutbox marked every non-HTTP failure ambiguous. Classification now uses the preserved cause code. A 503 body containing ENOTFOUND stays ambiguous. Timeouts, resets and other response errors stay ambiguous.

PRRT_kwDOSYpJkM6vA2RJ is valid: a retry continued posting later rows in the same drain. drain now stops after a retry. A blanket stop would leave every later destination behind a persistently refused oldest row, so the next drain orders by attempts, then rowid. One refused destination cannot block every other notification on the following drain.

Behavioural revert proof, each function restored after the failure:
- classifyOutboxSendError pre-request branch reverted: transport regression failed, actual ambiguous, expected retry.
- postToSlackOnce cause removed: transport regression failed, actual cause code undefined, expected ECONNREFUSED.
- drain break removed: retry regression failed, actual sends first and second, expected first only.
- drain order reverted to rowid: retry regression failed, next drain sent first, expected second.
- example exitCode removed: example regression failed, actual exit 0, expected 2.
- example fetch classification removed: example regression failed, pending count actual 0, expected 1.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented all five supplied findings. Destination changes now park refused receipts at zero added attempts and continue; explicit skip records skipped without claiming delivery, and restoring the original route permits explicit retry. Ambiguous outcomes hold later rows for the same destination within a drain, while reads never drain and lifecycle hooks attempt at most one request. Reconciliation has an explicit force override for verified PID reuse through SDK and --force-reconcile; the default still protects active senders. Recovery stages each verified history file before publication, isolates bad streams, drains healthy queued/new receipts, and exposes recovered.failed with a nonzero history_unavailable partial report in JSON and TOON. Recovery eligibility is snapshotted at enable; explicit configure records a future-only epoch, so widening filters before the first scan cannot backfill stale messages. Existing SDK queues without saved policy still drain; enable/configure adopts future history. Policy lookup is indexed per timestamp so concurrent future configuration is observed without receipt-table scans. SDK example handles partial recovery and parked refusals with nonzero exit status. Core suite passed 234 tests with 100% lines/branches/functions for index.ts and outbox.ts; new directed suite passed 11 tests and SDK incomplete-history example passed separately. GitHub API access recovered: all review threads/comments were fetched with complete pagination; no unresolved GitHub threads remain. Latest CodeRabbit body is empty and latest substantive body has no outside-diff findings; neither substitutes for review of this new patch.
